items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: I did meet Jimmy in Chicago, although that was back in 1937.

ctx.x: band until they had this. Well by the way, um, speaking of Willie Bontag, I can't pronounce those French names, but Zutty, I used to know him quite well in New York. That's his nephew. And he used to tell me about his uncle, and so when I ran across him on the parade, I recognized the name as soon as I was introduced to the course. Didn't get to talk to him in a half a minute, of course. In those days I didn't, wasn't studying the history as much as I am now. Yeah, nah, yeah. But I was thinking about Zutty. Did…

Oh, I remember seeing pictures of Jimmy and hearing recordings of Jimmy. And I did meet Jimmy in Chicago, although that was back in 1937. But other than that, I didn't know too much other than what I hear.

You don't know where he learned, who he studied? No, I don't. I really don't. Because the reason why I ask is that he seems to have something in common with your style and Omosimeon's style. I wondered if he was a T.O. student too.
